title: Flowcharts default to Mermaid; a diagram whose layering Mermaid cannot hold is a static SVG
context: ADR-0142 makes Mermaid with Pele the format for interactive flowcharts. Some diagrams are about layers, with each layer reading strictly below the one that calls it, and an auto layout may break that order.
decision: Draw a flowchart as Mermaid source in InteractiveFlowchart, as ADR-0142 says. Group nodes in one subgraph per layer when the diagram is layered, and check the rendered rows keep the intended top-down order. Only when the layout cannot hold that order, draw a static SVG in the repository diagram style instead and reference it. ADR-0142 is unchanged by this exception.

alternatives.reason: Loses node details and the maintenance advantage ADR-0142 chose Mermaid for, when Pele can hold the layers.
Its decision still holds for every diagram Mermaid can lay out; only an exception is added.

consequences: Authors verify layer order before choosing a format; the entry write flow on the persistence Feature page holds its layers in Mermaid.
revisitTriggers: Pele subgraph layout stops keeping layers in order.
